title: How Customers can Conserve Natural Gas and Cut Costs this Winter
summary: GASTONIA, N.C. – Dominion Energy is reminding customers of programs and tools to help them manage their natural gas use and hold down costs during the colder months. Dominion Energy expanded its conservation program offerings in recent years to provide customers with more options to help them reduce their energy usage and bills. “Natural gas use increases this time of year, and we have a number of programs available to help our customers manage their bills, including free energy efficiency upgrades to help the most vulnerable,” said Rusty Harris, Vice President and General Manager of Dominion Energy North Carolina-Gas. “We’re also here to help with payment concerns associated with higher winter bills.” Reduce natural gas consumption by making these simple changes: Set the thermostat at 68 degrees or lower during colder months. Each degree above 68 will gradually increase energy costs. Caulk, seal and weather-strip around all seams, cracks, and openings – especially exterior doors
